# Zhangjiajie Guide
> Your independent travel guide to Zhangjiajie National Park — tickets, trails, seasons, and everything you need before you go.

## Core Pages
- [Complete Guide](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/guide/): Everything about visiting Zhangjiajie: tickets, transport, hiking, accommodation, and insider tips.
- [Tickets & Prices](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/tickets/): Entrance fees, combo passes, where to buy, and money-saving advice for 2026.
- [Top 10 Attractions](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/attractions/): From Avatar Hallelujah Mountain to the world's longest glass bridge.
- [1, 3 & 5 Day Itineraries](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/itinerary/): Field-tested plans with timing and budgets.
- [Best Time to Visit](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/best-time-to-visit/): Season-by-season breakdown with weather, crowds, and prices.

## Planning
- [How to Get There](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/how-to-get-there/): Flights, trains, buses — door to door directions.
- [Where to Stay](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/hotels/): Wulingyuan town, city center, and inside the park.
- [Weather & Climate](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/weather/): Monthly temperature, rainfall, and what to pack.

## Explore
- [Hiking Trails](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/hiking-trails/): Difficulty levels, distances, estimated times, scenic highlights.
- [Avatar Mountains](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/avatar-mountains/): The real-life inspiration for Pandora's floating mountains.
- [Glass Bridge](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/glass-bridge/): Everything about the world's longest glass-bottom bridge.
- [Photography Guide](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/photography/): Best sunrise spots, camera settings, lens recommendations.

## Practical
- [FAQ](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/faq/): Quick answers to the questions every first-time visitor asks.
